method: ONE task-level score (Oct 21, 2026): per task automatable = 1-(1-AI)(1-robot); points = % of time x automatable (points_ai / points_robotics split in proportion to the two fractions; they add up to combined_time_weighted). AI fraction (capability rule): max of the Eloundou label score (E1 = 1; E2 = 1 when observed use or a verified product shows software exists, else unused; E0 = 0), Anthropic task penetration and the ILO 2025 score. Driving tasks: share of instances in settings where a deployed/commercial driverless system operates (any vehicle class; capability, not adoption). Earlier fields below kept. Each task has a time share (Anthropic time share where published, otherwise 1/n; normalised to sum to 100%) and an automatable fraction 0-1 (ai_automatable / robotics_automatable, with _basis continuous / tier / mixed / not_physical and the sources). AI = mean of the available per-task evidence: Anthropic Economic Index task penetration (continuous: share of the task covered by work-related use, automated use at full weight, augmentative at half), ILO 2025 GenAI task score (continuous, same-statement ISCO-08 tasks) and the Eloundou et al. 2023 label (tier-based: E1 = 0.5 and E2 = 0.25, from the definition that the LLM cuts task time by at least half and the half weight the paper gives E2; E0 = 0). Robotics = share of the task instances (by weight) a cited robot can do in the instance's own setting (Legate-Yang & Massenkoff 2026, continuous; never below the deployed-robot cover), 0 for tasks the source rates non-physical. ai_points / robotics_points = time share x fraction / time share of tasks with evidence, so they add up to ai_time_weighted / robotics_time_weighted. Tasks with no evidence are left out (not counted as 0). Per O*NET task: AI-exposed = Anthropic Economic Index task penetration > 0 (observed AI use); robotics-exposed = Anthropic robot exposure tier E1-E3; safe = rated in either source and neither; no_data = in neither source. Eloundou et al. (2023) GPT-4 label is shown as extra evidence (E1 direct, E2 with tools, E0 none). Time = Anthropic time_share (equal weights when missing). Work activities, skills and abilities are linked only through official O*NET 31.0 files: tasks_to_dwas, gwas_to_iwas_to_dwas, essential/transferable_skills_to_work_activities, abilities_to_work_activities; each element's ai_share / robotics_share / safe_share is the share of its linked task time in each group (a task's time is split evenly across its DWAs). Technology is occupation-level (O*NET has no task link).
